segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You take a deep breath, puff out your chest, and belt out at the top of your lungs:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: JINGLE BELLS! JINGLE BELLS! JINGLE ALL THE—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instantly, all three soldiers freeze mid-step. Their painted wooden jaws drop wide open. Inside their chests, copper gears grind and screech in agony as their internal programming violently collides with the unfinished tune.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Compelled by ancient holiday magic, the soldiers snap their heels together, raise their arms in stiff choreography, and burst into a deafening, mechanical three-part barbershop harmony:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: —WAAAAAY! OH WHAT FUN IT IS TO RIDE IN A ONE-HORSE OPEN SLEIIIIIGH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: While the soldiers are locked in their four-part vibrato, completely powerless to stop singing, you sprint right under their wooden noses, barrel through the emergency doors, and burst out into the freezing alley!
